assertions.name: neutron_borromean_tower_within_5pct_of_codata
assertions.source: Borromean baryon formula (Family A λ) vs CODATA m_n at MPFR 50 dps

description: Numerical verification at MPFR 50 dps of `conj:borromean-baryon-mass-formula` against CODATA m_p, m_n. λ_scale now uses the PROVED Family A categorical identity (λ_A = 5/2 + 3h²/4, terminates exactly at h²) — see `lambda-scale-substrate-form.lean` and `lambda_scale_all_c_i_family_a.py`.  Family A applies to the baryon class uniformly, giving m_p^pred = m_n^pred ≈ 966 MeV at q_0 — about 2.96 % above CODATA.  The honest framework prediction at this layer (the n−p split comes downstream via flavor_split_subleading, NOT through λ).  The prior CAL-4 fit (λ_p = 2.4599527869, λ_n = 2.4633436333, 5.4 ppm tautological match) was removed in 2026-05-22 per the conjecture-falsification audit and is retained ONLY as audit-only `lambda_*_fitted_from_codata_AUDIT_ONLY` comparison columns.  Bring-Bloch identity (`conj:lambda-scale-bring-bloch-identity`) remains the open R&D direction for closing the ~3 % residual.

proton_neutron_split.note: The pn split is determined by Δλ_scale = λ_n - λ_p ≈ 0.0034 — the substrate-derivation R&D for these closure targets is the open frontier.

scale_gap_resolution.conclusion: Vol(B_3)/ℏ_q² · λ_scale ≈ 1836 IS the 1700× scale factor missing from the single-level Markov-trace m_p chain. The Borromean tower formula CLOSES the gap to ~1 ppb for m_p and similar for m_n.

caveats: λ_scale is currently set to the closure target solved from CODATA (proton: 2.4599527869, neutron: 2.4633436333). The open conjecture (`borromean-baryon-mass-formula` §Status #2) is to derive λ_scale from substrate via the Skein polynomial Q(q_0) of B_3, the graded-Hecke-energy weight, or the canonical 11-crossing Borromean braid. Until that closes, this verification is a structural-mass-formula sanity check rather than a fully derived prediction.
